verdict.rationale: Factory's docs say that when a Linear or Jira issue is delegated, Droid will "investigate, implement, and test the work," and they describe QA on autopilot. That points to agent-run testing as part of its own implementation flow, but the docs never say the agent writes new tests or gates its proposals on passing results. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic test generation, a documented validate-before-propose loop (run tests, fix failures, then propose), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically generate and run tests to validate its own code changes before proposing them

citations.quote: Assign a Linear issue to Factory or mention `@Factory` in an issue comment to have Droid investigate, implement, and test the work.
Assign a Jira issue to Factory or mention `@Factory` in an issue comment to have Droid investigate, implement, and test the work.
